info.title: ltx/ltx-video-alpha-gen
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "ltx/ltx-video-alpha-gen", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

post.summary: Queued-only: this route answers 403 not_enabled for ltx/ltx-video-alpha-gen; use POST /v2/models/ltx/ltx-video-alpha-gen/requests.

schema.description: Request body for `POST /proxy/ltx/v2/video-alpha-gen`. On Comfy Router this model runs on the queued route only (`POST /v2/models/ltx/ltx-video-alpha-gen/requests`): a job can outlast the time a synchronous call is held, so the synchronous route refuses it.

video_uri.description: Input video as a publicly accessible HTTPS URL or a base64 data URI. H.264 or HEVC in MP4, MOV or MKV, up to 200 MB by URL. At most 3840 pixels on the long side and 2160 on the short side.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for LTX AlphaGen: the terminal `LTXVideoAlphaGenJobStatusResponse` poll document, forwarded unchanged. The job is submit-and-poll and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished job (`status: completed`) rather than the task handle the underlying submit returns.
`result.matte_video_url` is the grayscale alpha matte and `result.cutout_video_url` is the input video with that matte as its alpha channel. There is no `result.video_url`. `result` is only present on a completed job. Output URLs expire 24 hours after completion, so download promptly rather than storing the link. A failed job carries `error.type` and `error.message` instead of `result`.

result.description: Present when status is completed; output URLs expire 24 hours after completion

cutout_video_url.description: URL of the input video with the matte as its alpha channel, a ProRes 4444 MOV

matte_video_url.description: URL of the grayscale alpha matte, an MP4 in which white is foreground
